title: isodon macranthus var. prainianus
intro: Isodon macranthus var. prainianus, commonly known as Prain's isodon, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prain's isodon include analgesic, anti-rheumatic, and anti-cough effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as caffeic acid, rosmarinic acid, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Prain's isodon have been shown to exhibit neuroprotective and anti-cancer activities, making it a potential candidate for further research in the development of novel therapeutic agents.
